errors.invalid_characters: Use only letters, digits, spaces and standard punctuation.
errors.surrounding_spaces: The password cannot start or end with a space.
errors.too_long: The password can have at most {{max}} characters.

event.description: Use it to join every lobby of this event. Keep it to yourself.
event.title: Lobby password

settings.from_series: This event follows its series. While the event is upcoming, saving the series again replaces a password set here.
settings.help_changes: A change applies to lobbies created afterwards. Lobbies that already exist keep their password.
settings.help_shared: Every lobby of the event uses this password, so anyone who has it can join any of them.
settings.keep_placeholder: Leave empty to keep the current password

leak.fixed: If it leaks, set a new one here and recreate the event's lobbies that are still waiting: existing lobbies keep the old password.
leak.regenerate: If it leaks, regenerate it and recreate the event's lobbies that are still waiting: existing lobbies keep the old password.
leak.series_random: If an event's password leaks, regenerate it in that event's settings and recreate its lobbies that are still waiting.

settings.overrides_series: This event overrides its series' password. While the event is upcoming, saving the series again replaces it with the series' setting.
settings.random_new: A password is generated when you save.
settings.random_series: Each event of the series gets its own generated password.
settings.title: Lobby password
